description: Retry one account's failed, blocked or needs-you target now, still approved. Its options stay as they are, and this is the call behind the post page's "Post to TikTok again" button. A failed target never went out, so it retries at once; a needs-you one may already be live, so agents get a confirm_token step: ask the person to check the network first (or, after a TikTok or YouTube refusal of a setting, to make the change it asked for). The next attempt replaces error_message.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

target_id.description: ID of one network's copy of a post (a UUID): the targets list in post_get

name: target_retry
title: Retry publishing
